name: Cyrillic 2 Latin
author: Desperado House - Cvijetin Maletic

sections.description:
With this plugin you can translate WordPress from (Serbian, Russian, Bullgarian, Macedonian, Ukrainian, Greek, Makedonian, Armenian, Georgian, Kazakh) cyrillic to latin

Available language :
English

To contribute in translating this plugin contact me : cvijetin.maletic@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to “wp-content/plugins/” directory
  2. Activate it in plugins section.
sections.faq:
How do i use the plugin?

  • Install and activate the plugin
  • It is all, it is automatic be convert from cyrillic to latin.
sections.changelog:
